commands.label: Decode the actual emitted IW5 procedure and opcodes
commands.stdout:
GSC Tool 1.5.1.359 created by xensik
disassembled iw5/hello.gscasm

decoded_main:
// IW5 GSC ASSEMBLY
// Generated by https://github.com/xensik/gsc-tool

sub:main
		OP_checkclearparams
		OP_GetString "Hello, "
		OP_GetString "World!"
		OP_plus
		OP_CallBuiltin1 println
		OP_DecTop
		OP_End
end:main
toolchain: xensik GSC Tool 1.5.1.359 IW5 PC compiler and disassembler
reproduction_command: gsc-tool -m comp -g iw5 -s pc hello.gsc && gsc-tool -m disasm -g iw5 -s pc <hello.gscbin>
semantic_scope: The community IW5 PC compiler compiled the unmodified source. Its disassembler exposed the emitted string computation and println call, whose operand reconstructs the exact greeting. Scope is the generated instruction sequence.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
